decisive_items: variant of unknown significance in the coding gene of cardiac ryanodine receptor (RyR2)
response.rationale: The combination of stress-triggered polymorphic VT, normal cardiac structure, and a RyR2 variant strongly supports CPVT, whereas the other options are either arrhythmia descriptions or lack supporting evidence.

rejected.why: Ventricular fibrillation is a consequence of the underlying arrhythmia, not the most specific diagnosis.
Ventricular tachycardia is a description of the arrhythmia, not the underlying syndrome.
Normal echocardiography and absence of typical ECG/imaging features make ARVC unlikely.
